text:
elaine-finance: Quick update: new exception route for time-sensitive vendor renewals and emergency infra purchases. Effective immediately. Details here: https://redwood.company/finance/exception-flows :rotating_light:

procurement-bot: POLICY NOTE by @elaine-finance
- Emergency infra purchases up to $25k: use `/procure emergency` + exec sign-off. Finance will attempt a 24-hour turnaround.
- Time-sensitive renewals (up to $15k) for vendors on "Approved SaaS" list: fast-track form available. No PO if criteria met.
- Any contract amendments still need legal review regardless of amount.

elaine-finance: If you hit a vendor outage and need immediate tooling, submit the emergency form and add a short justification + link to incident ticket. Finance & Ops will triage.

omar-ops: Example: our monitoring vendor outage yesterday required $8k in extra ingest. Would that be emergency?

procurement-bot: Yes if the spend restores production service and you have an incident ticket. Use `/procure emergency` and attach the incident ID.

omar-ops: Got it. Also, do we still prefer virtual cards for one-off emergency buys?

elaine-finance: Prefer virtual card when possible. For immediate wire transfers or vendor portals that require a company card, state the reason and attach approval.

trevor-sales: Sales frequently upsells seats and we sometimes need immediate top-ups to avoid service disruption for customers. For seat add-ons < $15k, can sales use the time-sensitive renewal route?

elaine-finance: Yes, if vendor is on Approved SaaS list and there is exec sign-off. Seat-count changes that create a new contract amendment require legal; minor seat top-ups under the vendor's existing contract can use fast-track.

legal-amy: Heads-up: even for fast-track, please attach the latest vendor T&Cs or amendment. Legal will only waive review if no contract language changes.

elaine-finance: SLA targets: emergency route = 24 hours (aim), fast-track renewals = 48-60 hours. We'll publish weekly metrics starting next month.

omar-ops: Appreciate the clarity. One ask: can finance publish a short checklist for `/procure emergency` so engineers don't forget attachments?

elaine-finance: Yes  checklist will be added to the form: incident ID, exec sign-off, vendor invoice or portal screenshot, GL code suggestion, and cost center.

trevor-sales: Thanks. Forwarding to sales ops.

elaine-finance: Policy version: 2026-03-27_exceptions_v1. Archived prior doc at https://redwood.company/finance/archive

procurement-bot: automated reminder: link posted to #all-hands for Friday walk-through.

elaine-finance: I'll do the walkthrough and record it. Drop edge-case scenarios here or DM me.

omar-ops: will do. thanks! :thumbsup:
